name: Nightshard Fissures
introDiscord: Black crystal fissures swallow nearly every trace of light. Nightshard Morays hide inside the cracks, which means every suspicious hole now deserves personal distrust.
introTwitch: Black crystal fissures swallow nearly every trace of light. Nightshard Morays hide inside the cracks, which means every suspicious hole now deserves personal distrust.

nightshard-fissures-approach.prompt: Three passages cut through blackglass walls. Reflections move where nothing should be moving.

left.message: A Berry rests beneath Shizuki's lantern beside a note: "Lost three lanterns here. If you find one inside a Moray, it belongs to the Moray now."

right.message: A star-chart coffer gleams faintly beneath the blackglass.

forward.message:
A dark crack suddenly develops eyes.

Nightshard Moray.

You knew that crack looked suspicious.

nightshard-fissures-depths.prompt: The fissures narrow until every wall contains dozens of Moray-sized hiding places.

left.message:
A Nightshard Moray lunges from a crack you inspected twice.

It was apparently waiting for dramatic timing.

right.message: Shizuki's emergency tonic sits beneath a lantern marked: "For bites caused by walls."
right.fullHpMessage: The bite medicine remains untouched. Congratulations on not being attacked by architecture yet.

forward.message: A meteor-iron reliquary lies behind a curtain of blackglass shards.

nightshard-fissures-threshold.prompt: The fissures converge around Blackglass Maw. Three dark routes lead toward a chamber where even reflected starlight disappears.

left.message: Star Candies glitter inside a fractured comet seam. You poke the surrounding cracks first. Sensible.

right.message:
A pair of eyes opens inside the wall.

Then a mouth.

There it is.

forward.message: Shizuki's final bottle reads: "Moray rule: suspicious hole = fish until proven otherwise."
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the bottle untouched and adopt Shizuki's surprisingly sensible Moray rule.

boss-antechamber.name: Blackglass Maw
boss-antechamber.prompt: The surrounding Morays vanish into their cracks. Something much larger moves behind the blackglass.

bossPromptDiscord:
A tremendous jaw-shaped shadow passes across Blackglass Maw.

The surrounding fissures suddenly feel much too small.

Use /yes to enter Blackglass Maw or /no to retreat before the wall develops even larger teeth.
bossPromptTwitch:
A tremendous jaw-shaped shadow passes across Blackglass Maw.

The surrounding fissures suddenly feel much too small.

Use !yes to enter Blackglass Maw or !no to retreat before the wall develops even larger teeth.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw. Several ordinary Morays peek from their cracks once the larger presence is gone.

boss.revealText:
The blackglass fractures and a colossal jaw erupts from the darkness.

Eclipse-Jaw Moray reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Eclipse-Jaw Moray disappears into the fissures.

You look suspiciously at the nearest wall.

The wall behaves.

For now."
